"""Independently reduce all30 captured offset tensors;no new model calls."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save,guard
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V174-spread-matching-v1';plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
record=read(root/'offset-observations-v1.json');scores=read(root/'scores-v1.json');design={c['id']:c for c in read(plan['design']['path'])['observations']};rows={r['id']:r for r in scores['rows'] if r['method']=='V174-EMA'};previous=read(plan['baseline_offset_diagnostic']['path']);baseline={r['id']:r for r in previous['observations']}
assert record['new_matching_calls']==0 and len(record['rows'])==6 and {r['id'] for r in record['rows']}==set(plan['offset_probe_cases'])
scales={'down1.0':2,'down2.0':4,'body.0':8,'up2.1':4,'up1.1':2};grid=np.asarray([(y,x) for y in [-1,0,1] for x in [-1,0,1]],np.float64).reshape(1,9,2,1,1);observations=[];count=size=0
for row in record['rows']:
 case=design[row['id']];old=baseline[row['id']];assert row['input']==case['arrays']==old['input'] and row['parent']==case['parent']==old['parent'] and row['index']==rows[row['id']]['index'] and row['output_values']==rows[row['id']]['values'];assert row['endpoint']=='EMA' and {b['name'] for b in row['blocks']}==set(scales);blocks=[]
 for b in row['blocks']:
  path=Path(b['array']['path']);assert ref(path)==b['array'];raw=np.load(path);assert fingerprint(raw)==b['values'] and raw.dtype==np.float32 and np.isfinite(raw).all();n,_,h,w=case['output_shape'];scale=scales[b['name']];assert raw.shape==(n,18,h//scale,w//scale) and b['native_pixels_per_feature']==scale and b['residual_bound']==9
  offset=9*np.tanh(raw.astype(np.float64).reshape(n,9,2,h//scale,w//scale));distance=np.sqrt(np.sum(((offset+grid)*scale)**2,axis=2));learned=np.sqrt(np.sum((offset*scale)**2,axis=2));old_block=next(q for q in old['blocks'] if q['name']==b['name']);count+=1;size+=path.stat().st_size
  blocks.append(dict(name=b['name'],array=b['array'],raw_values=b['values'],native_pixels_per_feature=scale,total_sample_distance_native_percentiles=np.percentile(distance,[0,50,90,99,100]).tolist(),learned_offset_distance_native_percentiles=np.percentile(learned,[0,50,90,99,100]).tolist(),fraction_total_distance_above_16=float(np.mean(distance>16)),fraction_total_distance_above_32=float(np.mean(distance>32)),fraction_total_distance_above_64=float(np.mean(distance>64)),tanh_saturation_fraction=float(np.mean(np.abs(np.tanh(raw.astype(np.float64)))>.9)),baseline_V172=old_block))
 observations.append(dict(id=row['id'],input=row['input'],output_values=row['output_values'],blocks=blocks))
assert count==30 and size==plan['projected_offset_array_bytes']==102780672
save(root/'offset-audit-v1.json',dict(status='pass30-offset-arrays-six-primary-EMA-quality-bindings-and-independent-position-reduction',capture=ref(root/'offset-observations-v1.json'),baseline=plan['baseline_offset_diagnostic'],arrays=30,bytes=size,observations=observations,new_neural_forwards=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),scope='Captured FP32 pre-tanh fields from6 existing primary-EMA quality forwards;positions reconstructed with NumPy FP64 and the pinned kernel equation. Not exact retained CUDA coordinates,whole-model receptive field or causal RGB influence.'))
for r in observations:print(r['id'],[(b['name'],round(b['total_sample_distance_native_percentiles'][2],3),round(b['fraction_total_distance_above_32'],4)) for b in r['blocks']])
print('PASS30 saved tensors/102780672bytes;no extra inference')
